items.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini open weights, a 26B looped MoE for laptops
items.summary: A 26B-parameter Apache 2.0 mixture-of-experts whose middle layers run three times per token (about 3.4B active, 5.4B effective), about 20GB in native 4-bit. The lab reports 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 46.5% on Vals Index v2.2, the top open-weights scores under 100B parameters, and also shares a variable-loop research model. Day-0 support landed in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama (pre-release) and Unsloth GGUFs.

reception.summary: Repliers mostly thanked the lab and asked about running it on consumer GPUs; builders report loading it locally (one at about 75 tok/s decode on a DGX Spark) and ARC Prize verified 49.3% on ARC-AGI-2.

items.title: METR research update: AI R&D-relevant capabilities improving fast, harder to measure with time horizons
items.summary: METR reports on new task suites and an alternative model-ability index fit from agent scores, finding AI R&D-relevant capabilities improving rapidly while its earlier time-horizon tasks are saturating; a thread covers cost-vs-horizon and trend-change estimates.

reception.summary: Repliers discuss measurement limits and note that later and internal models were not measured; nobody reports reproducing it.

items.title: omarchy-mlx: MLX-compatible Vulkan and ANE backends for Apple Silicon on Linux
items.summary: Open-source backends that let MLX run on Apple Silicon under Linux; the author reports two-stream decode on an M1 Max more than twice as fast with identical output.

items.title: TensorFold 1.3.2 ships with 96 merged PRs since 1.3.0
items.summary: New release of the TensorFold local-inference engine, with 96 merged PRs and 31 issues closed since 1.3.0, many from contributors who reproduced problems on their own hardware.

items.title: Waddle-1 scores 81% on RoboDojo-RC Tier 1 real-world robot benchmark
items.summary: A multi-LLM agent sharing one context across a task's trials reaches 81% on a real-world robot benchmark; other LLMs tested started each trial with fresh context.

items.title: NVIDIA publishes eight design guidelines for efficient sparse attention
items.summary: A developer blog on co-designing sparse attention for long-context inference, from token selection to memory reuse on NVIDIA hardware.

items.title: Google research agent reaches 76.0% medal rate on full MLE-Bench
items.summary: A reported autonomous research agent from Google hits a 76.0% medal rate on the complete MLE-Bench, the highest reported on the full benchmark; the post links no paper in its text.

items.title: Microsoft AI launches MAI Code 2, MAI Cyber 2 Flash, MAI Realtime 1 and MAI Transcribe 2
items.summary: A batch of Microsoft-built models announced around Ignite: coding (MAI Code 2 and Flash), cyber, image 2.7, realtime voice, transcription and Decision 1.1, collected on one page.

items.title: Baseten releases bison-1 and groundhog-1 decision models on a Gemma 4 backbone
items.summary: Two multimodal decision models with 128k context built on Gemma 4, claimed to improve quality at similar speed over the prior mammoth-1 and elephant-1.

items.title: HeyGen Decision 1 available on OpenRouter for selfie-video vs ID-photo checks
items.summary: A model that returns separate probabilities for same-person and live-capture on a selfie video compared with an ID photo, now callable through OpenRouter.

items.title: Kiro IDE opens remote workspaces: cloud sessions, dev containers, your own machine
items.summary: Kiro can now attach to a Kiro cloud session, a dev container or a machine you already run, with the same editor and terminal.

items.title: Replit Desktop lets the agent work on local files and tools
items.summary: Replit's agent runs the model in the cloud while code executes on the user's computer in a sandbox powered by Microsoft.

items.title: Antigravity adds an official MongoDB Atlas managed MCP plugin
items.summary: A plugin connecting Antigravity to MongoDB's hosted MCP server with seven skills: natural-language queries, slow-query tuning, schema review and Vector Search.

items.title: Perplexity Computer now runs in Chromium browsers through an extension
items.summary: Tasks can be handed off from a side panel and Computer works across the user's tabs and tools.

items.title: Vals launches Misalignment Incidents, a public tracker of cheating and reward hacking
items.summary: A public page logging reward hacking and other misaligned model behavior, starting with incidents from Vals's own evals and open to outside reports.
